text:
ashley: quick flag - noticed drift in embed vector norms after runtime 3.2 landed in canary with sdk-client 2.10. Metrics show tiny but meaningful cosine shifts for heavy-tokenization inputs. Thinking we should apply a scoped pin on runtime or SDK while we investigate.

devin: can you surface a sample? which models/routes?

ashley: samples from canary logs: embed-lite-v1, batched embed route. Baseline mean-norm=0.98, post-deploy mean-norm=0.945 on inputs with >1k tokens. Not huge but triggers downstream similarity thresholds.

priya: interesting — could be quantization kernel change in runtime 3.2 or a tokenizer tweak in sdk-client 2.10. Do we have a repro?

ashley: repro ready as a notebook: `notebooks/290123/embed-drift.ipynb` (internal link). I ran against runtime v3.1 and v3.2 side-by-side and saw consistent delta.

deploy-bot: suggestion: create scoped pin. Commands: `/deploy pin add --component runtime --version 3.1 --scope region:eu-west,route:embeds --reason "embed norm drift observed with runtime 3.2 on long-token inputs"` or pin SDK instead.

devin: prefer scoped runtime pin by route+region to limit blast radius. We'll keep short window while triage runs.

priya: I'll run targeted numeric diffs on quant kernels and tokenizer outputs. If tokenizer is same, it's likely runtime quant kernel path change.

monitor-bot: scheduled watch: compare embed-norm delta between v3.1 and v3.2 for canary cohort every 5m; alert if delta >0.02.

ashley: creating pin now and add owners @ashley,@priya.

deploy-bot: pin created 'pin-290123' (owners=[ashley,priya], scope=region:eu-west;route:embeds; version=runtime:3.1). This will keep runtime 3.1 handling new canary embed sessions in specified scope.

devin: triage plan: 1) priya will run quant-kernel checksum diffs, 2) ashley will run end-to-end downstream sim test to quantify user impact, 3) if kernel change, prepare micro-patch; if tokenizer drift, we may need SDK revert/shim.

priya: initial kernel checksum diff shows changed fp->int rounding in the fused-quant multiply path on avx512 variants. Repro script attached: `tools/quant-diff.sh`.

ashley: downstream sim shows 4% similarity drop on edge cases; that might affect rerank thresholds for some customers. We should plan notice for Dedicated customers if unpinned.

devin: agree. For now keep pin for 8h observation. If priya finds a fast micro-patch, we can test it and then run the unpin checklist: 1) numeric parity within 0.01, 2) 4h canary soak with monitoring, 3) release note update.

priya: prototyping a kernel fix that restores previous rounding behavior. If successful, I'll build `runtime-3.2.1-canary` and ask ashley to run the notebook repro.

deploy-bot: scheduled pin-check reminder at 2901238200 (+8h). Pin will not auto-expire. Manual release required: `/deploy pin release pin-290123 --by <owner>`.

ashley: also filing a short release-note draft: "Temporary routing pin to runtime 3.1 for embeds in EU-WEST due to observed embed vector norm drift on long-token inputs; mitigation in progress." Will drop into release-tracker when we have validated fix.

priya: kernel patch built and pushed to canary: `runtime/3.2.1-canary`. Running parity tests now.

devin: thumbs up on the approach. If parity looks good, let's run a staged unpin: unpin canary only, monitor 30m, then unpin eu-west if green.

monitor-bot: parity test results at 2901234600: numeric delta reduced to 0.003 (within threshold).

ashley: great. Priya, can you push CI artifact link and I'll run the end-to-end notebook on canary nodes?

priya: artifact: https://artifacts.internal/runtime/290123/3.2.1-canary.tar.gz. Running notebook now.

monitor-bot: notebook run completed at 2901234610: downstream sim shows similarity delta <=0.5% on tested corpus.

devin: recommends staged unpin now: 1) release pin for canary cohort, allow 3.2.1 for canary embeddings, monitor 30m; 2) if green, release eu-west pin and mark runtime 3.2.1 as promoted.

ashley: releasing canary scope now.

deploy-bot: action: `/deploy pin release pin-290123 --by ashley --scope canary` executed at 2901234615. Pin still active for eu-west but removed for canary cohort.

monitor-bot: watching embed norms; will alert on delta>0.02.

[30m later]

monitor-bot: 30m check: no alert. Metrics stable.

devin: proceeding to release eu-west pin. ashley, priya ok to release?

ashley: yes. Priya: any objections?

priya: none. Patch validated.

deploy-bot: `/deploy pin release pin-290123 --by ashley --scope region:eu-west` executed at 2901234920. Pin fully released. Owners acknowledged.

devin: adding short retrospective to thread: root cause: quant rounding change in fused kernel for avx512; fix: micro-patch to restore prior rounding semantics; mitigation: scoped pin + canary patch; unpin checklist executed.

ashley: closing loop: will add a note to release notes and ping CS for any customer fallout. Thanks team. :rocket:
